extracted.intended_audience: NIAID extramural community, NIAID staff, and NIH extramural offices
extracted.subtask_description: Describes the responsibilities and operational standards for the NIAID Office of Extramural Research Policy and Operations (OERPO) in developing, implementing, coordinating, and overseeing extramural policies, procedures, compliance, and submission processes. Covers liaison duties with NIH offices, Council review support, and intramural application submission facilitation.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate responses to directorate and NIH OER requests
rubrics_metrics.description: Leads and coordinates responses to correspondence, requests, and data calls from the NIAID Office of the Director and NIH's Office of Extramural Research.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acts as the central contact point for responding to inquiries and data calls from institute and NIH-level leadership and extramural oversight offices.

rubrics_metrics.name: Develop, implement, and disseminate extramural policy and procedures
rubrics_metrics.description: Leads and coordinates developing, implementing and disseminating policy, procedures, and other guidance related to extramural program activities.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Create and publish guidance documents and procedural instructions to ensure consistent execution of extramural programs.

rubrics_metrics.name: Design systems to improve effectiveness and mitigate extramural risks
rubrics_metrics.description: Develops and implements systems, procedures, and operations aimed at improving the effectiveness and mitigating the risks of NIAID extramural activities, including managing the NIAID Director’s and DEA Director’s extramural conflicts of interests and recusals.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes procedures for identifying and managing conflicts of interest and recusals for senior officials; focuses on operational risk reduction and process improvement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Oversee and advise on extramural policies and procedures (peer review, appeals, submissions, special programs)
rubrics_metrics.description: Oversees and provides advice on extramural policies and procedures—including peer review appeals, application submission, and special grant programs—to the extramural community and NIAID staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide authoritative guidance and advisory support on policy interpretation, appeals handling, and special program implementation for staff and external applicants.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate compliance for Research Using Select Agents and biohazards
rubrics_metrics.description: Oversees and coordinates activities related to compliance with requirements for Research Using Select Agents and biohazards.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Ensure extramural programs meet federal regulatory and biosafety requirements for select agents and hazardous biological materials.

rubrics_metrics.name: Plan and phase extramural initiatives across internal and NIH offices
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinates the planning of NIAID extramural activities, including the phasing and review of research initiatives, with DEA offices and programs, other divisions within the Institute, and the NIH Office of the Director.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Align timing, review stages, and program rollouts across internal divisions and NIH-level offices to support coherent initiative management.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serve as FOAM coordinator and NIH Guide liaison
rubrics_metrics.description: Serves as the NIAID coordinator and Liaison for the NIH Funding Opportunity Announcement Management (FOAM) system, including the early notification of all non-NIAID funding opportunities and Notices and all negotiations with the NIH Guide staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Manage FOAM workflows, ensure timely notification of opportunities/notices, and negotiate content/format with NIH Guide staff.

rubrics_metrics.name: Serve as liaison with NIH Office of Extramural Research and CSR
rubrics_metrics.description: Serves as the liaison with the NIH Office of Extramural Research and Center for Scientific Review.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Maintain working relationships and communication channels with NIH extramural oversight and peer review centers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Support final scientific and programmatic Council review and materials
rubrics_metrics.description: Performs a full range of activities necessary for final scientific and programmatic review of all initiatives by the National Advisory Allergy and Infectious Diseases Council. Coordinates scientific and programmatic presentations and other subcommittee activities of Council and all aspects of the Electronic Council Book.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Prepare briefing materials, coordinate presentations and subcommittee inputs, and manage the Electronic Council Book contents for Council review.

rubrics_metrics.name: Coordinate preparation for Council review of grant applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinates within DEA and program divisions to prepare for the final review of grant applications by the National Advisory Allergy and Infectious Diseases Council.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Work across divisions to ensure grant applications are review-ready and that necessary programmatic context is provided to Council reviewers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Manage intramural application submission processes (eRA Commons, Grants.gov)
rubrics_metrics.description: Coordinates all activities regarding the submission of applications by NIAID intramural program, including creation of eRA Commons accounts and submission of applications to Grants.gov.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide operational support for intramural applicants, including account setup and electronic submission logistics.
